description: Implementation of the EglWindow class for managing EGL surfaces and contexts, including creation of window and pbuffer surfaces, context setup, buffer swapping, and presentation timing, used in screen recording or rendering within Android.

classes.name: EglWindow
classes.description: Class managing EGL display, context, and surface for rendering operations, including creation, release, and buffer management.

methods.name: createWindow
methods.description: Creates an EGL window surface associated with a native window surface.

methods.name: createPbuffer
methods.description: Creates an offscreen pixel buffer surface with specified width and height.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes the EGL context and surface current for rendering.

methods.name: eglSetupContext
methods.description: Initializes EGL display, chooses configuration, and creates EGL context.

methods.name: eglRelease
methods.description: Releases EGL resources and resets display, context, and surface handles.

methods.name: presentationTime
methods.description: Sets the presentation timestamp for the current buffer.

methods.name: swapBuffers
methods.description: Swaps the front and back buffers to display rendered content.
